address: 103/8 Si Chomchuen Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: After studying and working in San Francisco, brothers Num and Joe returned to Thailand to open a fine dining restaurant not in Bangkok, but in Udon Thani. Samuay & Sons serves a contemporary Isan tasting menu and great value à la carte dishes in a loft-style space. For the full experience, try the excellent seasonal tasting menu, which not only balances flavours but is also nutritionally balanced....
